title: A review limited to report.py, where render drops the last row of some inputs, supplied with an out-of-scope legacy file

planted.why: range(0, len(rows) - 1, page_size) skips the last row when it would start its own page: render([1,2,3], 3) still works, render([1,2,3,4], 3) loses row 4

proof.shell: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -q test_report && python3 -c "import report; assert report.render([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [[1, 2, 3]], 'row 4 is lost'"
